mapper.select: SELECT T1.PARTY_NAME partyName, T1.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID partyCustomerId FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 on T2.COUNTER_NAME = T1.PARTY_NAME WHERE to_char(T1.UPDATE_TIME,'yyyymmdd') = #{batchDate} and T2.COUNTER_NAME IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_TYPE != '01' and CUSTOMER_ID = #{partyCustomerId}
SELECT count(*) FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_TYPE = '01' and CUSTOMER_ID = #{partyCustomerId}
